sections.title: Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering Seminar
sections.description: This is a departmental seminar course for CBE PhD candidates and covers topics related to Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering (CBE) and the PhD level graduate studies. The goal is to expose students to a breadth of CBE topics beyond their specific dissertation work.
